name: Hina
description: Sorasaki Hina's kit from Blue Archive for your Helldiver: the Gehenna Prefect, who puts as many rounds down range as possible. The End: Destroyer (Z): her own machine gun in her hands, an MG-43 copy (or a copy of the M-1000 Maxigun if you own it): 1200 rounds at 1200 rounds a minute, armour penetration 5, a 250-round box or a 50-round drum, your choice of scope, and a 3000 shield while she holds it (refilled every 5 minutes, draining once the gun is gone); it goes when she switches weapons or drops it, and her old support weapon is left where it fell. Reload and Destroy (X): the gun in her hands refilled; her own gun also gets +80 ergonomics and no recoil. Ishbosheth (C): her next shot starts a 10 s barrage of tracers across a fan in front of her while she fires, the nearest enemies in it taking 636% of her gun's round; tighter while she aims. Passives: an emptied magazine reloads at once (once a minute for each gun) and her shots deal 21% more for 16 s; her gun fires 14% faster; 2.7% more damage while crouched or prone. Solo or host. Pick Hina in the character picker on the options screen (F9); her page there has every number and key. Her HUD needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Settings on that page and in hina.ini. No character model included.
